BLACK_WHITE_CARROT.title: Black-White Carrot
BLACK_WHITE_CARROT.flavor: A twin carrot said to grow where the King of Bountiful Harvests trod.
BLACK_WHITE_CARROT.description: At the start of combat, summon Glastrier and Spectrier and Feed 11 to both. Both steeds shield Calyrex from damage. Each arrives bearing a mark.
SERENE_GRACE.title: Serene Grace
SERENE_GRACE.description: The first 3 debuffs you apply each combat are doubled.
FOCUS_SASH.title: Focus Sash
FOCUS_SASH.flavor: It clings to life by a thread.
FOCUS_SASH.description: When you would take fatal damage, survive at 1 HP instead. This relic is then used up.
NEVER_MELT_ICE.title: Never-Melt Ice
NEVER_MELT_ICE.flavor: Ice that never melts, even in summer.
NEVER_MELT_ICE.description: While riding Glastrier, upgrade all Glacial Lances.
SPELL_TAG.title: Spell Tag
SPELL_TAG.flavor: A tag said to draw spectral power.
SPELL_TAG.description: While riding Spectrier, upgrade all Astral Barrages.
EVIOLITE.title: Eviolite
EVIOLITE.flavor: It strengthens those who have yet to fully grow.
EVIOLITE.description: While not mounted, gain 6 Block at the start of each turn.
MULTISCALE.title: Multiscale
MULTISCALE.flavor: A shimmering shield at full health.
MULTISCALE.description: Take 50% less damage while at full HP.
EXP_SHARE.title: Exp. Share
EXP_SHARE.description: The first unupgraded card you play each combat is temporarily upgraded.
MIRACLE_SEED.title: Miracle Seed
MIRACLE_SEED.description: At the start of combat, gain 2 Abundance.
LOADED_DICE.title: Loaded Dice
LOADED_DICE.description: While mounted, X-cost cards have X+2.
DISGUISE.title: Disguise
DISGUISE.description: At the start of combat, gain 1 Buffer.
SNOW_CARROT.title: Snow Carrot
SNOW_CARROT.flavor: A frosty carrot from the Crown Tundra.
SNOW_CARROT.description: At the start of combat, Feed 20 to both steeds and grant each a mark.
KING_ROCK.title: King's Rock
KING_ROCK.description: Each attack has an 8% chance to [gold]Stun[/gold] its target.
ABILITY_CAPSULE.title: Ability Capsule
ABILITY_CAPSULE.description: On pickup, add [gold]Innate[/gold] to up to 6 [gold]Power[/gold] cards. The first 2 Power cards you play each combat are free.
LEAGUE_WEAK_RELIC.title: Stage Fright
LEAGUE_WEAK_RELIC.description: Gain 2 Weak at the start of your next combat.
